name: energycore-outages
description: Read-only transmission outage search, binding constraint drivers, and market conditions from tioscore_production.
long_description: The trading desk's outage and shadow price search for Claude Desktop. Runs locally and reads tioscore_production through your SSH tunnel (default 127.0.0.1:3309), and the S3 caches through your normal AWS credentials (~/.aws). Start the tunnel before using the tools.

db_username.title: Database username
db_username.description: Your tioscore_production MySQL username (mysql_slave: username in config/mysql.yml).

db_password.title: Database password
db_password.description: Your MySQL password. Stored in the system keychain.

db_host.title: Tunnel host
db_host.description: Local end of the SSH tunnel to the database.

db_port.title: Tunnel port
db_port.description: Local port of the SSH tunnel to the database.

tools.name: list_upcoming_outages
tools.description: Transmission outages planned to start on a day.

tools.name: get_outage_documentation
tools.description: Desk notes and shadow price history for one outage.

tools.name: list_binding_constraints
tools.description: Constraints that bound on a day, largest shadow price total first.

tools.name: get_constraint_drivers
tools.description: Data for explaining why one constraint bound on a day.

tools.name: get_market_conditions
tools.description: Hourly energy prices, RTEP, and stress index for a day.

tools.name: get_autoflow
tools.description: Hourly flow that zonal wind, solar, and load put on a constraint.

tools.name: get_outage_impacts
tools.description: How much each outage in effect loads one constraint.
